A wide steaming pool rimmed in rounded dark boulders settled unevenly on a cliff shelf, the entire valley below swallowed by a sea of cloud that reaches the rim's edge, one boulder worn to a smooth shallow dish that holds a little water of its own.

A long steaming bath enclosed in pale cypress planks built onto the top storey of a tall wooden inn, the town far beneath spreading in every direction, a single overflow notch cut into the near corner of the lip.

A small steaming pool edged in rain-worn grey stones set inside a dense stand of bamboo, the canes arching directly over the water so their tips nearly touch the centre, one gnarled root grown tight around the largest rim boulder.

A steaming bath cut into one vast river boulder mid-stream, the cold current parting and sliding around its flanks on three sides, a single flat rock standing proud just inside the near edge where a foot might find purchase.

A wide steaming pool of uneven rain-worn stone built against a hillside face, fed by a narrow waterfall pouring straight into its far end from a cleft above, one mossy scoop worn into the lip to guide the overflow back into the ground.

Three steaming pools terraced down a steep hillside in descending steps of settled dark basalt, each spilling a thin sheet into the one below through a natural low point at its rim, the lowest pool edged by a crooked stepping stone set apart from the path.

A steaming pool sitting on a ledge in a narrow gorge, the walls rising close on both sides and an old rope bridge crossing high above its open centre, one small stone step worn smooth descending into the water.
A long steaming bath on a sea-cliff shelf of dark volcanic stone, surf breaking on black rock far beneath its outer edge, a hollowed log carrying water in from a crack in the cliff face behind.

A wide steaming pool set in a field of black volcanic rock, thin drifts of steam rising from cracks in the surrounding ground in thin unhurried drifts, three rim boulders of differing height settled at uneven angles.

A deep steaming pool edged in rounded pale fieldstone sitting at the margin of a frozen lake, the ice beginning a single step from its outer rim, one stone at the corner worn to a smooth dish by long use.

A steaming pool set in a moss garden, a narrow stone channel of cold water running just beside its near rim, the two never mixing, a single flat stepping stone standing slightly proud of the channel's edge.

A circular steaming pool of rain-darkened boulders settled under one enormous ancient leaning pine, its lowest branch extending out over the centre of the water, a gnarled surface root curling around one rim stone at the waterline.

A steaming bath built on a deck of broad cedar planks standing on tall wooden posts out over a fast river, the current rushing through the posts below and visible through gaps in the decking, a mossy scoop cut into the outer lip.

A round steaming pool of irregular fieldstone set inside a ring of standing rocks, a small red-railed footbridge crossing the gap in the ring at the near side, one rim stone shifted and sitting lower than the rest.

A wide steaming pool on an open terrace of settled dark stone facing a distant volcano cone across the breadth of a whole valley, one overflow notch worn into the outer rim aimed directly at the cone.
A steaming bath of pale rounded stones running the full length of a tunnel formed by arching maple branches whose canopy closes overhead, one crooked stepping stone placed apart at the near entry.

A wide steaming pool edged in soft green-patched boulders sitting on the floor of a fern gorge, a tall thin waterfall dropping into a shallow trough behind its far wall and filling it from beneath, a hollowed log carrying the overflow back out.

A round steaming pool cut into an open flat of pale volcanic rock, one weathered torii standing at its far rim with its posts sunk into the ground, a single small stone step descending into the pool at the near side.

A shallow steaming pool cut into a tidal rock shelf of wave-worn dark stone, the sea retreating and returning through channels in the rock beyond its outer edge, one rim edge worn lower than the rest where the tidal water occasionally tips in.

A long steaming bath under a great hanging curtain of wisteria vine trained across a broad timber frame overhead, the vine's old woody stems twisted along each beam, a single flat rock standing proud in the middle of the pool.

A small steaming pool set in a walled garden with a raked-gravel apron on three sides, one crooked stepping stone placed at an angle apart from the three even ones along the near edge, the rim boulders mossy and unevenly settled.

A wide steaming pool on a hillside shelf of settled rain-worn granite, the whole lit inn-town strung in a long arc below and visible over the outer rim, one boulder at the corner worn into a smooth dish by water pooling on it.
A steaming pool cut into the floor of an old caldera, its outer wall dropping away to reveal the open sea beyond the far lip of the basin, three rim stones of uneven height on the seaward side.

A long steaming bath running beside a thick stand of tall grasses on a river flat, the grasses leaning in over the near edge of the water, a narrow overflow notch cut into the far lip where the water drains quietly toward the river.

A deep steaming pool built against the base of a sheer cliff face that closes off its entire far side, the raw stone of the cliff descending straight into the water, one small stone step at the near rim worn at an angle by generations of entry.
